chunks: It was narrated from Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Anṣārī that he said:

ʿAlī عليه السلام led us in salat at Barāthā after his return from fighting the Shurāt, and we were about one hundred thousand men. Then a Christian came down from his monastery and said, "Who is the commander of this army?" We said, "This one." So he approached him and greeted him, then said, "O my master, are you a Prophet?" He said, "No. The Prophet, my master, has died." He said, "Then are you the successor of a Prophet?" He said, "Yes."

Then he said to him, "Sit down. How is it that you asked about this?" He said, "I built this monastery because of this place, and it is Barāthā. And I read in the revealed books that none prays in this place with this gathering except a Prophet or the successor of a Prophet. And I have come to submit and accept Islam."

So he accepted Islam and went out with us to al-Kūfah. Then ʿAlī عليه السلام said to him, "Who prayed here?" He said, "ʿĪsā ibn Maryam عليه السلام and his mother prayed here." Then ʿAlī عليه السلام said to him, "Shall I inform you who prayed here?" He said, "Yes." He said, "Al-Khalīl عليه السلام."

key_terms.الشُّرَاةِ: the Khawārij, referred to here as the group fought by Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.بَرَاثَا: Barāthā, the location where the prayer and encounter took place
key_terms.عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ: Jesus son of Mary عليه السلام
key_terms.وَصِيُّ: the designated successor of a Prophet

ai.seo_question: How does the hadith of Barāthā describe the recognition of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as the successor of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a historical incident at Barāthā in which a Christian monk recognized the rank of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام through what he had found in earlier revealed scriptures. The report highlights the Imam's position as the waṣī of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the sanctity of Barāthā as a place where great divinely chosen figures prayed.
